National Identity Cards
†*121. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a state of
uncertainty about the announcement made
by the Government a few years back for
issuing the National Identity Cards to all
citizens in the country;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether due to the non-issuance of
such National Identity Cards, Government
are not in a position to arrest the persons
who are living in India illegally; and
(d) if so, Government’s reaction
thereto?
Rapid Action Police Force
*122. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Rapid
Action Police Force (RAPF) was formed
basically to deal with urban violence and
communal violence;
(b) if so, whether any analysis of RAPF
being successful in achieving its objectives
has been made;
(c) what is the percentage of different
religious Minorities in this force; and
(d) the steps being taken to improve its
working?
Violence and crimes against women
*123. SHRIMATI VANGA
GEETHA:
SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state the legislative measures
taken to curb domestic violence and crimes
against women particularly in the light of
demands of national women’s
organisations?
Arrest of Delhi Police officials
*124. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of Delhi Police officials
arrested during the last four months;
(b) the nature of offence for which they
have been arrested;

Revival of Kolar Gold Fields
*125. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
revive Kolar Gold Fields in Karnataka;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) how many employees have already
taken VRS in the above unit;
(d) when the revival is expected to take
place; and
(e) the estimated cost for such revival?
Barbed wire fencing along Indo-
Bangladesh Border in Tripura
*126. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) how far the erection of barbed wire
fencing along Indo-Bangla border in Tripura
has been completed;
(b) the number of dwelling houses on
the other side of the fence  belonging to
residents of the State of Tripura;
(c) appropriate steps being taken to
provide alternative houses to the affected
families; and
(d) by when the work of fencing is likely
to be over?
Plight of villagers in drought affected
districts of Tamil Nadu and
Karnataka
*127. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOP-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn to the news report informing
that villagers, mainly farm labourers, in the
drought affected districts of Tamil Nadu
and Karnataka have been eating rats to
satisfy their hunger;
(b) if so, the details of investigation
carried out, if any, into the plight of the
affected farm labourers;
(c) reasons for not enabling the affected
villagers to access reliefs under the Central
Government funded/sponsored anti-
poverty programmes and food security
scheme, particularly, SGRY and SGSY;
and
(d) steps taken, if any, pursuant to the
news report to ameliorate the condition of
the affected families so far?
Concessions sought by weavers of
Andhra Pradesh
*128. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether a delegation of Andhra
Pradesh weavers has sought certain
concessions and measures to revive
handlooms, handicrafts and powerlooms
in the unorganised sector; and
(b) if so, the details of their demands
and the action taken thereon?

(c) if so, what other measures are being
considered and by when they are likely to
be announced?

Effect of rise in coal prices
302. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the steep
rise in coal prices has its cascading effect in
prices of steel and power sector in the
country;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that the
beneficiary common man is severely
affected by the rise in prices of prime grade
coal; and
(c) whether Government have received
representation from the steel and power
industry to reconsider the decision?
Recommendations of World Bank
regarding extraction of coal, oil and
gas
303. SHRI  MANOJ  BHATTACHARYA:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Extractive Industry
Review of the World Bank has made some
recommendations with regard to extraction
of coal, oil and gas;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the position of Government thereto?
Copper reserves in Uttaranchal
†304. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) the locations of copper reserves in
Uttaranchal and the quantum thereof;
(b) whether any scheme for commercial
exploitation of the said copper reserves has
been formulated by Government; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Setting up of non-coking coal
washeries by C.I.L.
305. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Coal India Ltd. has taken
any steps to set up non-coking coal
washeries within the jurisdiction of each
subsidiary coal company of Coal India Ltd.,
in view of increasing likely demand of non-
coking coal because of Government's plan
to increase power generating capacity in
the next decade;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether private investors are also
likely to be attracted to set up washeries;
and

Coal mine workers
†306. SHRI ISAM SINGH: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of workers working
in coal mines at present;
(b) whether Government propose to
totally exploit mining of coal mines; and
(c) if so, the number of extra workers
required in this regard?
Revival plan of ECL
307. SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the status of revival plan of Eastern
Coal Fields Ltd. (ECL); and
(b) the outlines of the revival plan
including financial involvement, funding
pattern, time schedule to implement the
revival scheme?
Pollution survey by WCL in
Chandrapur, Maharashtra
†308. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Western Coalfields Ltd. had
conducted any survey with regard to
pollution in Chandrapur district of
Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the details thereof together
with the number of members in the
concerned survey team;
(c) whether the said team has submitted
a report;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Coal mines in the country
309. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise details regarding the
number of mines in the country;
(b) the State-wise details regarding the
number of mines closed/abandoned during
the last three years;
(c) the total number of workers who
lost their jobs due to the closure/abandon-
ment of mines during the above period;
(d) whether Government have any
revival package to modernise the mines in
the country;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Import of Coal
†310. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the demand
of coal in different industries in the country
is being met through imports;
(b) if so, the names of industries and
the average quantum of coal imported
annually; and
(c) the reasons for which these
industries are forced to depend on imports?

the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have procured Sukhoi-30 MKI planes from
Russia recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the total number of fighter aircrafts
in operation in the country at present?
